moneyFees.title: Costs & fees
moneyFees.sub: Your own cost figures that the profit numbers use: payment gateway fees, packaging, the USD rate and the courier rates. Empty until you enter them; nothing here charges anyone.
moneyFees.badAmount: Write the amount as a number, for example 25.
moneyFees.readOnly: You can see these figures. Changing them needs the "Costs" permission.

fees.title: Payment gateway fees
fees.sub: What each gateway keeps of a payment: a share in % and a fixed amount. A gateway not listed has no known fee.
fees.provider: Gateway (as in Keys & connections, e.g. bkash)
fees.bad: Check each row: the gateway in small letters, a share from 0 to 20 %, a fixed amount as a number.

pack.title: Packaging per order
pack.sub: What packing one order costs (box, bag, tape, tag). Leave empty if not known.
pack.rto: The costs of a returned parcel (courier charge, packaging, handling) are on

usd.title: USD rate
usd.sub: How many {currency} one US dollar costs, for the AI costs paid in dollars. A new rate counts from now; the old ones stay for their days.

cards.title: Courier rates
cards.sub: What each courier charges per delivery band and weight band, the COD fee and the return charge. A rate is ended, never changed; enter the new one after it.

err.INVALID_INPUT: Something is not filled in right. Check the numbers.
err.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else saved this a moment ago. Open the page again and check.
err.forbidden: You do not have the permission for this.
